chunks.docTitle: Vyom Agents (Vyom Autonomous Intelligence) is a premier enterprise Agentic AI & AI Automation company.
chunks.content:
Vyom Agents (Vyom Autonomous Intelligence) is a premier enterprise Agentic AI & AI Automation company.
Brand Pitch: "Unlocking infinite possibilities in autonomous technology. We architect intelligent Agentic AI ecosystems and enterprise AI automation products that transform complex operations into deterministic, 24/7 self-executing workflows."
Core Thesis: "Beyond Automations. Deploy Autonomous AI Workforce Today."

The Fragility of Legacy Tools:
Traditional workflow tools (Zapier, Make.com, legacy RPA bots) rely on brittle "if-this-then-that" rules and rigid XPath/CSS selectors. The moment an external API schema updates, a web UI shifts, or an unexpected edge case occurs, legacy bots fail catastrophically.
Vyom's Paradigm Shift:
Vyom Agents engineers sovereign, multi-agent systems with self-evaluating reasoning loops, dynamic tool calling, and self-healing visual automation. When interfaces relocate, the systems dynamically re-plan and auto-remediate without human babysitting.

Key Operational Metrics:
• Sub-400ms Voice Latency (typically 320ms end-to-end for STT, LLM reasoning, and TTS streaming).
• 99.4% Multi-Step Task Accuracy with automated self-healing verification loops.
• 10x Operational Throughput Multiplier: continuous 24/7 autonomous execution capacity.
• 100% Deterministic Tool Safety guaranteed by sandboxed execution harnesses and strict role-based policy guardrails.

Target Verticals:
Healthcare and Dental Clinics, Legal Firms, Multi-location Service Businesses, Logistics & Supply Chain, Financial Services, and High-growth SaaS Enterprises.

chunks.docTitle: The AI Receptionist is Vyom Agents' flagship live enterprise product for 24/7 inbound reception, multi-provider triage, and intelligent outbound patient/client campaigns.
chunks.content:
The AI Receptionist is Vyom Agents' flagship live enterprise product for 24/7 inbound reception, multi-provider triage, and intelligent outbound patient/client campaigns.

Technical Specifications & Capabilities:
• Ultra-Low Latency: Operates with sub-400ms latency (typically 320ms end-to-end). Callers experience natural, immediate human cadence with zero conversational dead-air.
• Interruption Tolerance: Callers can interrupt mid-sentence naturally; the agent ceases speech instantly and adjusts context dynamically without stuttering.
• Deep Calendar & EHR Integration: Bidirectional synchronization with Google Calendar, Microsoft Outlook, Cal.com, Dentrix, Epic, AthenaHealth, Salesforce, HubSpot, and custom SQL databases.
• Multilingual Fluency: Native conversational fluency in 45+ languages including English, Hindi, Hinglish, Spanish, French, German, and Mandarin with localized regional phonetics.
• Multi-tenant Telephony Carrier Integration: Direct integration with Twilio, Asterisk, SIP trunks, and WebRTC. Handles 15+ concurrent calls per business line with zero hold times.
• Security & Compliance: SOC-2 Type II infrastructure, HIPAA compliant for protected health information (PHI), and end-to-end TLS 1.3 audio encryption.
• Business ROI: Eliminates 100% of missed after-hours calls, boosts appointment booking conversions by +42%, and replaces up to 3 receptionist phone desk shifts (~120+ manual phone hours per month).

chunks.content:
Vyom's Autonomous Workflow Orchestrator is a next-generation self-healing RPA engine that completely replaces brittle legacy RPA bots (UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Selenium).

Technical Architecture:

• 99.8% Auto-Healed Recovery Uptime: When an ERP, CRM, or external portal shifts UI elements or changes layouts, the engine calculates semantic vector likeness and auto-remediates the target selector in real time without downtime.
• Embedded AI Compliance & Audit Agent: Performs real-time document verification, invoice extraction, cryptographic token signing, and immutable audit logging.
• ROI & Labor Savings: Eliminates 180+ hours of manual data entry per team each month, providing 300% more resilience and zero maintenance overhead compared to legacy automation scripts.
